title: Giving Armstrong lessons to rebuild his chops in 1934
summary: After France Armstrong's lip was sore and he lost his callus; Randolph gave him exercises, to the amazement of drummer Gable.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yeah, that's what I -- yeah, now you got the idea. Now, I'm a trumpet teacher, and in fact, sort of like Gable, when I was working out with Louis. You know, Louis came back from France, and this was the time for this other band that I was talking about --
Yes, Yes, let's go into that, (inaudible)

And I had to -- when I was playing a gig with a drummer, and he came by my home and my wife said, 'He's down to Louis', so Gable came down to Louis' and he had to sit there and wait til I was finished giving Louis a lesson. And Gable said --
Wait a minute. You were giving Louis Armstrong a lesson?
Oh, yes, yes, uh-huh, yes. Now, this is off the cuff. Don't nobody know anything about that, because
you're the only one that know that now. And Gable -- and he's dead --
Gable, though, he was a drummer?
Gable was a drummer.
Well, what was the rest of his name?
What was Gable --
You just called him Gable.

Yeah, only way I knew him was Gable. Little fellow, just about my color, only he was kind of cross-eyed. But he played a whale of a drum, you know. And he had a gig, and I had that gig with him. It was his gig, and I was playing trumpet. And he remarked, he says, "Randolph, if I hadn't seen this with my eyes, I never would have believed it." I said, "What?" "You sitting down there, giving Louis a lesson." I said, "Well, I'm showing Louis how to work up and get his chops worked back up, see."
Yeah, he had chop trouble when he came back.
Yes, he had chop trouble.
What had happened?
I don't know. He hadn't played in a good little while, then when he just started playing, the chops got real sore, and --
He had lost that callous?
Yes, and I was working with him this
way, and giving him exercises to work with, and he and I were sitting there, working on the exercises.
To strengthen his lip.
Yeah, to strengthen his lip. And then Gabel (inaudible) I say, you working with Louis. I says, well, that's nothing, just regular routine.
